title: About Us
text:
Viva Facility Services --

## About us

VIVA is one of the fastest growing facility in Safety & Security, House Keeping & Multi- Skilled Manpower agencies in the industries. We believe only in Quality standard & Satisfaction of our Prestigious Clients.

We are the Pioneer and competent Fire & Safety Management by which we maintain highly Safe & Healthy Environment inside the Client Premises.

We Provide well trained the Zeal Safety assistants for the Safety management which restricts to mishaps.

Outsourcing of work is not only an IT industry process but is also prevalent on a large scale in other industrial sector. The concept of “core competence” in management is gradually being adapted by all Indian industries. Therefore, any process or job that does not fit into the core activity of a company is outsourced to a professional agency. VIVA understands the need of Indian industry and their quest for professionals who can become strategic partners to facilitate in a certain areas of business. Services such as Housekeeping, Security, Manpower supply, Garden Maintenance, job contracting, Logistics etc. are some of crucial areas of medium and large scale industries. At the same time, these tasks require practiced and skilled professionals so that work is up to the quality standards. Our objective is “Increased productivity with Reduced Cost while maintaining efficiency and Quality Standards.”

## Why VIVA ?

Our services are not just restricted to establishments like shopping malls, hotels, Corporate and offices; VIVA also provides its services for events and exhibitions of any kind.

At VIVA we believe in maintaining high standards of quality and service. For us quality is more important than quantity and that is the reason why we do not take to many assignments at one time, whatever assignments we take receive our complete attention and focus. For VIVA quality of service and client satisfaction always comes first.

The company has kept itself updated on ever changing needs of establishments and provides cost effective solutions to its clients.

## Why Only VIVA ?

Priority status to our valued clients by paying more attention which already grown security organization can not provide.

#### 3 Tier Training Program

- Site specific Training
- Industry specific Training
- Basic Guarding Training

#### On-the-Job (OJT) Training :

- Regular Security audit by VIVA professional team to recommend change for improved security.
- Security Survey of site by VIVA professional team.
- Optional training to client’s staff of security.
- Regular On-site & off-site training to update security skills; impart site-specific changes in security procedures; improve skill levels; refresh security skills; etc.

#### Regular visit for monitoring of site :

- Reasonable contacts with political, bureaucrats and law officials to help the customers in moments of turmoil.
- Non-unionized & motivated workforce.
- 24X7 accessibility at all levels within VIVA.
- Regular interaction by Marketing Dept for independent feedback.
- Monthly review meeting with clients to solve the security related issues/ difficulties.
- Escalation matrix provided with all contact details.
- Branch Head.Visit by Marketing Dept.
- Surprise night checks (twice-weekly) by Area-Managers Regular site visits by Area Manager;
